The same retailer's saxophone catalog also lists a soprano/tenor and piano Menuet. Preserve the soprano entry, add the missing piano, and distinguish editions.

An institutional composer catalog dates Menuet for oboe, clarinet, or saxophone and piano to 1975. This is separate from the 1998 issue date.
